name: H-One Co.,Ltd.
summary: H-One Co., Ltd. is an international maker and supplier of automotive and motorcycle components, dies and welding apparatus. Its automotive parts include front bulkheads, side frames, rear frames, pillars and door beams, and for motorcycles and power products it makes pushrods, yoke rotors and control levers. Dating from 1930 as Hirata Technical Co., Ltd., it was renamed in April 2006 and has its headquarters in Saitama, Japan.
